title: Divergence Estimates Schema
description: Defines temporal estimates of divergence times for internal nodes in phylogenetic hypotheses. Multiple independent estimates are preserved for each node, scoped to a hypothesis and source. Organized as a hierarchical structure: divergenceEstimates -> hypothesis ID -> node ID -> array of estimates.

divergenceEstimates.description: Divergence estimates organized by hypothesis. Keys are hypothesis IDs (e.g., 'phylo_mammals_1').

additionalProperties.description: Estimates for a single hypothesis, organized by node ID.
Array of independent estimates for this node from different sources. Multiple estimates are preserved without averaging.

sourceId.description: Stable identifier for this source (e.g., 'source_dos_reis_2018', 'source_springer_2004'). Used to link to source metadata.

centralEstimate.description: Central estimate of divergence time in millions of years ago (Ma). Must be >= 0.

statisticType.description: What the central estimate represents. Defaults to 'mean' if not specified. Important for proper statistical interpretation.

uncertaintyLower.description: Lower bound of uncertainty interval (Ma). Null if not available. Must be <= centralEstimate.

uncertaintyUpper.description: Upper bound of uncertainty interval (Ma). Null if not available. Must be >= centralEstimate.

uncertaintyType.description: Type of uncertainty interval (e.g., '95% credible interval', '95% confidence interval', 'standard deviation'). Required if uncertainty bounds are provided.

unit.description: Unit of time: 'Ma' (millions of years ago) or 'Ga' (billions of years ago). Defaults to 'Ma'.

methodology.description: Brief description of methodology (e.g., 'Bayesian relaxed clock', 'penalized likelihood'). Important for interpretation.

calibrationNotes.description: Notes on calibration points or methodological caveats. Optional but important for reproducibility.

source.description: Source identifier (e.g., 'doi:10.1038/srep33666'). Optional but recommended for traceability.

sourceAuthors.description: Authors of the source publication. Optional.

notes.description: Any additional notes about this specific estimate. Optional.

metadata.description: Overall metadata for the divergence estimates dataset.

source.description: Source or origin of these estimates. Optional.

license.description: License under which data is available. Optional.

accessDate.description: Date data was compiled or accessed (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

notes.description: General notes about the dataset. Optional.
